units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 7:3:2">Y. Yoma VII, 44ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני הג׳</he> to avoid the appearance of pride (on the Day of Atonement).

<cite ref="Chagigah 5b:10">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>גוה</he>, <cite ref="Jeremiah 13:17">Jer. XIII, 17</cite>) <he>מפני גַאֲוָותָן של וכ׳</he> over the glory of Israel that has been taken from him &c.
<cite ref="Jeremiah 13:17">Ib.</cite> <he>מפני גַאֲוָותָהּ של מלכות שמים</he> over the (lost) glory of the heavenly kingdom (the destruction of the Temple).
